When the engine is very hot, do not remove the coolant reservoir cap because there is a risk of burns.

1. Check the coolant level in the reservoir is between the MIN and MAX marks shown on the reservoir.

Always check the coolant level with the engine cold and the vehicle level.

2. If the level is too low, unscrew the engine coolant reservoir cap and top up with the specified fluid to the MAX mark.

The antifreeze in the coolant circuit ensures protection to a temperature of -40C.
